sources.title: Attention modulates responses in the human lateral geniculate nucleus
sources.authors: O'Connor DH, Fukui MM, Pinsk MA, Kastner S
sources.access_note: 摘要（无开放全文，付费订阅），核心数据来自摘要和McAlonan2008引用中的描述
sources.role: 核心参考，提供人类fMRI中LGN注意调制的首个直接证据（三种调制：增强目标/抑制干扰/基线提升，约4% BOLD效应）

sources.title: Guarding the gateway to cortex with attention in visual thalamus
sources.authors: McAlonan K, Cavanaugh J, Wurtz RH
sources.role: 核心研究；同时记录猕猴LGN和TRN单神经元；TRN响应先于LGN约4ms；量化注意效应（M+11%/P+9%/TRN-4%）；验证Crick TRN守门人假说

sources.title: Parallel processing in the corticogeniculate pathway of the macaque monkey
sources.role: 皮层-膝状体反馈通路特异性——三个CG神经元亚群分别对应M/P/K层，说明皮层对LGN的反馈是分流特异性的而非全局调制

sources.title: Thalamic functions in distributed cognitive control
sources.role: 框架综述；丘脑超越中继站的认知控制功能；三大机制（TRN门控/高次核中转/MD-PFC放大）

sources.title: Prefrontal Cortex Regulates Sensory Filtering through a Basal Ganglia-to-Thalamus Pathway
sources.authors: Nakajima M, Schmitt LI, Halassa MM
sources.role: PFC→BG→TRN跨模态感觉抑制通路（鼠类光遗传学）；注意视觉时主动压制TRN听觉子区；信噪比提升机制

sources.title: Control of visual cortical signals by prefrontal dopamine
sources.role: FEF多巴胺D1受体介导前额叶对V4信号的调控（提高幅度/朝向选择性/时间可靠性）；与TRN通路并行的皮层-皮层直接注意通路

sources.title: Spatial Attention Weakly Modulates Visual Responses in the Lateral Geniculate Nucleus
sources.authors: Alitto HJ, Johnson JS, Usrey WM
sources.role: 关键挑战：猕猴LGN电生理显示注意调制仅约1%放电率变化，远小于fMRI显示的效应；对LGN作为注意门控关键位点提出质疑

sources.title: Dynamic Modulation of Beta-Band Oscillations in the LGN and Their Role in Visual Processing
sources.authors: Alitto HJ, Sanchez AN, Alexander PC, Usrey WM
sources.role: LGN-V1相干β振荡在注意/警觉/视觉刺激时被抑制；提供注意影响LGN的非放电率机制
